units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:8">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ה׳ שיניך וכ׳</he> (Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ bot. <cite ref="E00010"><he>האי</he></cite>) how is that tooth of thine?—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:1:2">Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>היי די ליה אב</he>, v. <cite ref="E00363"><he>הַיְידָּא</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: (= הֵי) which? (generally with דֵּין or דָּא, v. הַיְידָּא, הַיְידֵּן). Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ אהיי דין … וה׳ דין וכ׳ (read היי) which wine was good for the bowels, and which &c.—
units: Y. R. Hash. I, beg. 56ᵃ ה׳ דין שני … וה׳ וכ׳ which sheni refers to months, and which to years?—Y. Meg. I, 72ᵃ top ה׳ לין אינון וכ׳ (= ה׳ אילין; Y. Succ. III, 54ᵃ top הַיְילֵין) which are the headings of chapters?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:7:1">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ</cite> top [read:] <he>כהיי דא מתניתא דר׳ חנין בשם ר׳ שמואל</he> with which of them does the Boraitha cited by R. Ḥ. … agree?—Ib. IX, 32ᵈ bot. [read:] <he>היי לין רבנין</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:5:3">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן אינון</he>) who are meant by ‘the Rabbis’?—With prefixes: <cite ref="K00518"><he>כַּיי</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00449"><he>לַיי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:31">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵃ</cite> top <he>כיי דמר ר׳ וכ׳</he> (= <he>כהא דאמר</he>) as (that which) R. … said.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:3:3">Y. Erub. III, 21ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.—Y. Shebu. II, 33ᵈ (<cite ref="L00453"><he>לַיְידָּא</he></cite>) <he>ליי דא מילה</he> with regard to what?; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:9:3">Y. Gitt. IX, end, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>ואדיין את ליי</he> (usually <cite ref="L00331"><he>לזו</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="A00397"><he>אֲדַיִין</he></cite>.
